intents.rationale: Add Response.apply_conditions implementing RFC 9110 precondition order.
make_conditional, is_resource_modified, is_byte_range_valid must warn and delegate.
make_content_range relies on is_byte_range_valid and doesn't clamp suffix; must validate inline and clamp.
send_file needs refactor to new methods, detection, seek, etag, default mimetype.
SharedDataMiddleware has its own serving logic and defaults.
Quickstart references make_conditional; changelog needs entry.
Tests for new methods; update old tests.

criteria.text: apply_conditions raises PreconditionFailed for failed If-Match/If-Unmodified-Since on any method, and for If-None-Match matches on non-GET/HEAD; evaluates in RFC order; star ETag honors exists.
apply_conditions turns the response into 304 with entity headers removed when If-None-Match/If-Modified-Since is satisfied on GET/HEAD, and sets Accept-Ranges: bytes.
apply_range always sets Accept-Ranges: bytes; leaves response unchanged for non-GET, non-200, or unknown/zero Content-Length.

apply_range uses only the first range, clamps too-large stop/suffix, raises RequestedRangeNotSatisfiable when unsatisfiable, else 206 with sliced data and correct Content-Range; ignores non-bytes units.
apply_range honors If-Range by strong ETag or Last-Modified match, otherwise returns the full response.
make_conditional, is_resource_modified and is_byte_range_valid emit DeprecationWarning and still work.

Range.make_content_range clamps too-large stop and suffix, uses first range, validates without is_byte_range_valid; from_header methods reject invalid values; ETagSet.from_header discards unquoted values.
IfRange.check returns True for matching strong ETag or equal date, False otherwise.
send_file detects name/size/mtime from file-likes, seeks to 0, ETag has no path hash, and defaults to application/octet-stream without download_name.
SharedDataMiddleware serves via send_file, sets no max-age by default, supports conditional and range requests, and warns when cache or fallback_mimetype is passed.
Quickstart documents apply_conditions and apply_range; CHANGES.rst has an entry.
New tests cover apply_conditions and apply_range; send_file tests updated; deprecated-function tests moved/removed; pytest -m 'not dev_server' passes.

tasks.summary: Add apply_conditions/apply_range and IfRange.check, fix Range/ETagSet validation, then migrate send_file and SharedDataMiddleware and their tests, and deprecate make_conditional/is_resource_modified/is_byte_range_valid last (internal callers must stop using them first since warnings may be errors). Update docs and changelog.
